mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (more than 1% quarter-over-quarter) indicates a weakening economy, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 drops and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending power diminishes.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (more than 1% month-over-month) signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts (more than 5% month-over-month) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (more than 0.2 percentage points) signals a strengthening demand side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate coupled with a rise in the consumer price index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded and monetary policy tightens.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL changes on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in nonfarm payrolls (more than 200,000 jobs added in the last month) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (more than 1% month-over-month) signals a strengthening demand side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
